user.title: To-do Sort
user.description: Adds sorting and Remove duplicates to the menu on the To-do page.

abort.already_configured: To-do Sort is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: To-do Sort is already set up.

sort.name: Sort to-do list
sort.description: Sorts the items in a to-do list by name. Ignores case and sorts numbers naturally.

order.name: Order
order.description: A to Z or Z to A.

set_auto_sort.name: Set auto-sort
set_auto_sort.description: Keeps a to-do list sorted by name whenever items are added or renamed. Set to off to go back to manual order.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Off, keep sorted A to Z, or keep sorted Z to A.

remove_duplicates.name: Remove duplicates
remove_duplicates.description: Deletes items that repeat another item's name, ignoring case. A copy that's still to do is kept over a completed one, and copies with their own description or due date are left alone.

cannot_reorder.message: {entity_id} can't be reordered, so it can't be sorted.

cannot_keep_sorted.message: {entity_id} can't be reordered, so it can't be kept sorted.

cannot_delete.message: Items can't be deleted from {entity_id}, so duplicates can't be removed.

no_target.message: Pick at least one to-do list.

invalid_order.message: Order must be alpha_asc or alpha_desc.

invalid_mode.message: Mode must be off, alpha_asc or alpha_desc.
